market.what: smoke-taint remediation of wine (RO + resin/carbon services, MIP filtration, carbon fining), mainly US/CA/AU
market.method: est.: ~12 ML/yr treated in avg year x ~$1.2/L (RO $1.70/gal/pass = $0.45/L x 2-3 passes + media); amaea alone 1.4 ML in 2 yrs

value.logic: est.: avg smoke loss ~$0.5B/yr (CA 2020 alone $3.7B; AU 2019-20 60 kt grapes, ~A$110M sales) x ~30% recoverable if taint removed without flavor loss
value.revenue_logic: avg 20 ML/yr treatable x 30% share x $0.5/L (half of RO cost)
value.margin_logic: specialty adsorbent media, reusable/regenerable; service partner takes part

trend.drivers: more extreme fires (UNEP: +14% by 2030, +30% by 2050); wine volume itself falling ~3%/yr

direct_startups: amaea (NZ, 2011; MIP filter VPx, 1.4 ML treated, 47+ clients)
competition.notes: amaea strongest: approved US/CA/NZ, Wine Australia rollout 2025 via VAF Memstar; FSANZ A1332 resin application. Bound glycosides (rebound) still unsolved.

lab.synth: 1-2 step custom: resorcinarene one-pot condensation + ester hydrolysis, 3 variants; immobilize for filter use
lab.test: real smoke-tainted wine: free volatile phenols GC-MS + glycosides LC-MS/MS (ETS, AWRI); aroma esters GC-MS; sensory triangle ISO 4120
lab.logic: synth 6 wk ~$12k; 4 wk tests: 30 x ~$250 = $7.5k (est.), sensory ~$5k, formulation ~$5k

sale.gates: TTB + FDA food-contact (resin) ~1 yr; FSANZ processing-aid ~1 yr; trial on 1 fire vintage (fire years unpredictable)
